war thunder.description: The ultimate vehicular combat experience where armor, wings, and naval guns clash in relentless, massive-scale warfare.

Carbon.description: Forged under immense pressure, this ultra-lightweight composite structure absorbs catastrophic damage while retaining lethal structural integrity.

Bung.description: A seemingly innocuous plug that seals explosive pressure, holding back catastrophic forces until the perfect moment of release.

Sassy.description: An unstoppable force of pure attitude, shattering enemy morale with devastating side-eyes and reality-bending comebacks.

VANGUARD.description: A towering juggernaut of bleeding-edge tech, breaking the frontline with impenetrable energy shields and world-ending artillery.

XB-70.description: Riding its own supersonic shockwave, the Valkyrie cruises at Mach 3, a titanium spearhead untouchable by anything less than a surface-to-air missile.

F-18HARV.description: The High Alpha Research Vehicle bends the laws of aerodynamics, utilizing thrust vectoring to outmaneuver any adversary in a deadly high-angle stall.

TU-160.description: The White Swan tears through the sky at Mach 2, delivering strategic devastation with unmatched elegance and raw, terrifying power.

F-14.description: The legendary Tomcat sweeps its wings back and dominates the horizon, intercepting threats from beyond visual range with the deadly Phoenix missile.

EF-2000.description: The Eurofighter Typhoon dances through the skies with delta-wing agility, unleashing a storm of precision-guided munitions on any who dare challenge it.

TU-95.description: The deafening roar of contra-rotating propellers announces the Bear, a relentless strategic bomber that haunts enemy borders with nuclear shadows.

F-18E.description: The Super Hornet commands the carrier deck, dominating dogfights and ground strikes alike with its massive weapons payload and unmatched versatility.

Vulcan.description: The delta-winged avenger howls through the clouds, delivering a thundering payload with an iconic, terrifying silhouette.

F-15SE.description: The Silent Eagle blends legendary dogfighting prowess with radar-evading stealth technology, striking from the shadows before vanishing into the ether.

KA52.description: The Kamov Ka-52 Alligator features side by side seating and coaxial rotors to dominate the battlefield with heavy ordnance and extreme agility.

TU-22M.description: The swing-wing Backfire terrorizes the oceans, launching hypersonic anti-ship missiles to obliterate entire fleets in the blink of an eye.

SU-34.description: The Fullback acts as a heavily armored flying tank, delivering devastating tactical strikes while shrugging off enemy air defenses with ease.

MI28.description: The Mil Mi-28 Havoc features heavy cockpit armor and an undernose cannon to annihilate ground targets in all weather conditions.

KA50.description: The Kamov Ka-50 Black Shark uses a unique single seat cockpit and high speed maneuverability to hunt enemy armor with surgical precision.

TU-16.description: The Badger carves a path of destruction, hunting carrier strike groups and heavily fortified land installations with devastating cruise missiles.

B-1.description: The 'Bone' pierces enemy airspace at supersonic speeds, hugging the terrain to deliver a catastrophic payload before the enemy even hears it coming.

AH-1Z.description: The Viper strikes with lethal venom, utilizing state-of-the-art targeting to turn enemy armor into burning scrap metal from miles away.

MI24.description: The Mil Mi-24 Hind combines massive firepower with a troop transport cabin to serve as a flying infantry fighting vehicle.

B-36.description: The colossal Peacemaker eclipses the sun with its massive wingspan, carrying an arsenal capable of turning entire cities into smoldering craters.

US Spec OP.description: Operating deep behind enemy lines, this phantom warrior executes high-value targets with silenced weapons and surgical, terrifying precision.

T-80.description: Powered by a screaming gas turbine engine, this flying tank blitzes enemy positions with terrifying speed and devastating firepower.

T-90.description: The glowing red eyes of the Shtora system stare down incoming missiles, turning this heavily armored predator into an unstoppable mechanized nightmare.

T-64.description: A technological terror of its time, featuring a lethal autoloader and composite armor to outgun and outlast anything in its path.

T-62.description: Introducing the smoothbore revolution, this steel beast pierces enemy armor with terrifying kinetic penetrators on the brutal frontlines.

Yak-130.description: The agile Mitten acts as the ultimate stepping stone, training the next generation of lethal aces while packing a surprising punch of its own.

T-55.description: The reliable workhorse of the Cold War, swarming the battlefield in endless numbers to overwhelm sophisticated armor through sheer volume.

US Private.description: The backbone of the infantry, charging into the meat grinder with an assault rifle, unwavering resolve, and a pocket full of sheer grit.

AH-64.description: The Boeing AH-64 Apache features a nose-mounted sensor suite and a 30mm chain gun to destroy enemy armor with Hellfire missiles.

B-52.description: The legendary Stratofortress rains apocalyptic payloads from the stratosphere, devastating entire grid squares with unrelenting carpet bombing.

B-47.description: The swept-wing Stratojet slices through the skies, pioneering modern bomber design while carrying the ultimate atomic threat.

B-58.description: The Hustler breaks the sound barrier in a delta-wing flash, outrunning interceptors to deliver tactical nuclear strikes with blazing speed.

DM73.description: The apex predator of kinetic penetrators, this advanced APFSDS round punches through composite armor like butter at hypersonic velocities.

CH-47.description: The CH 47 Chinook transports heavy cargo, artillery, and up to 33 troops using its tandem rotors and rear loading ramp.

JA37.description: The JA37 Viggen utilizes a double delta wing and thrust reverser to intercept aerial targets while operating from short, improvised road bases.

JA35.description: The Saab JA35 Draken operates as a supersonic interceptor that uses a double delta wing design to perform high speed climbs and engage aerial threats at high altitudes.

JAS39.description: The JAS 39 Gripen operates from short improvised road bases and requires minimal ground support for rapid refueling and rearming during combat missions.

F-16XL.description: The F 16XL uses a cranked arrow delta wing to double the internal fuel capacity and increase weapon carriage for long range flight missions.

X-59.description: NASA uses the X 59 aircraft to test quiet supersonic technology that provides data for updating regulations on high speed commercial flight over land.
